content.json:
## Cars — club activity

Source: `sor-frontend-ai-prod-usw`. Filtered by **ClubId** and car calls only (`CarSearch`, `CarBooking`, `/cars/`). Hotel calls stay on the Hotels workbook.

**Time range** refreshes the chart and the list. **Latest events** only limits how many rows the list shows.

content.query:
let clubId = tostring("{ClubId}");
union isfuzzy=true customEvents, traces, pageViews, requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend Club = tostring(customDimensions.ClubId)
| extend Club = iff(isempty(Club), tostring(customDimensions.VacationClubID), Club)
| extend Club = iff(isempty(Club), tostring(customDimensions.VacationClubId), Club)
| where isnotempty(clubId) and Club == clubId
| extend Signal = strcat(name, " ", operation_Name, " ", url)
| where Signal has "CarSearch" or Signal has "BackgroundCarSearch" or Signal has "CarBooking" or Signal has "CarLocationSearch" or Signal has "searchlocations" or Signal has "/cars/"
| summarize Events = count() by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Activity over time — {TimeRange:label}

content.query:
let clubId = tostring("{ClubId}");
let rowLimit = toint("{RowLimit}");
union isfuzzy=true customEvents, traces, pageViews, requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend Club = tostring(customDimensions.ClubId)
| extend Club = iff(isempty(Club), tostring(customDimensions.VacationClubID), Club)
| extend Club = iff(isempty(Club), tostring(customDimensions.VacationClubId), Club)
| where isnotempty(clubId) and Club == clubId
| extend Signal = strcat(name, " ", operation_Name, " ", url)
| where Signal has "CarSearch" or Signal has "BackgroundCarSearch" or Signal has "CarBooking" or Signal has "CarLocationSearch" or Signal has "searchlocations" or Signal has "/cars/"
| project timestamp, itemType, name, message, operation_Name, Club, customDimensions
| order by timestamp desc
| take rowLimit
content.title: Latest events in this range
